_doc: M3-CHR-05: the story clips the chapters' dialogue calls (`@anim <hero> <clip>`) past each hero's own clips, built by assets_src/characters/asha/hero_clips.py (see its M3-CHR-05 block for the gesture vocabulary). A spec is `frames` (15 fps) and either `alias` (a clip the hero already has, `reverse` to play it backwards) or a base posture (`from`, default stand; `to` with `change` = [start, end] fractions for a change of posture) plus `keys`: [u, [gesture, ...]] eased between. `like` names a spec in `shared`. One-shots hold their last frame; most gestures settle back to the base. act1-chapters may add clips here (a request task to characters). `field` holds the field-life clips (loops unless noted): idle and talk variants, a listening nod, and look_left/right/up/down key poses (two frames, the head and neck only on the idle's first frame) for a runtime look-at blend; HeroIdleMicro (hero-integration) layers breathing and weight shifts on top.
doc: Body clips the Act I dialogue (M3, m2-slice) stages with `@anim <hero> <clip>` that the heroes don't have yet: requested from the character track in docs/kb/tasks/M3/M3-CHR-1000-act1-body-clips.md. Until a clip is built its call is skipped at runtime (CutsceneSequencer checks has_animation). tools/tests/test_hero_clips.py allows these and still fails on any call that is neither built nor listed here (a typo). Remove a clip from here when it is built.
